Children:
We offer to our users a range of apps, some of which are primarily targeted at children below the age of 16 years, and others that are intended for users of all ages.
We generally do not process children's personal data on the basis of consent but, if we do, in the event we discover we have collected information from a child below the age of 16 years, we will either delete their personal data or immediately seek the parent's consent for that collection.
